items.observation: The `buildCodeAssets` early return and the shared hook_test.dart added to the five C/C++ siblings on 2026-09-23 are missing here (example: audio_decode hook/build.dart:22-24, CHANGELOG 1.3.5). There is also no code_assets dependency in pubspec. The hook does not read config today; whether the same failure occurs here was not measured.
items.proposed_fix: Add `code_assets: ^2.0.0`, add the guard line, add the test/hook_test.dart from the siblings, and record it in CHANGELOG.
items.closure_criteria: hook/build.dart returns early when input.config.buildCodeAssets is false, pubspec.yaml declares code_assets and test/hook_test.dart covers the code-asset-free path. CHANGELOG.md records the change.

items.observation: The C runtime malloc/free are bound directly with `@Native(symbol: 'malloc'/'free')`. The siblings deliberately avoid this because symbol lookup does not resolve on Windows (blake3_ffi, image_ffi and re2 bindings.dart:8-10). Why it works here is not documented.
items.proposed_fix: Export `sj_alloc`/`sj_dealloc` from the shim (allocation and deallocation in the same CRT) or document the resolution path in a comment + a Windows test.
items.closure_criteria: Either the shim exports sj_alloc and sj_dealloc and decoder.dart uses only those, or a comment documents the Windows resolution path and a Windows test covers it.

items.observation: The padded-copy skeleton appears in three places and the `64` literal nine times. The simdJsonDecodeBytes and simdJsonDecodeNdjsonBytes skeletons are the same.
items.proposed_fix: `const _simdjsonPadding = 64` + a `copyPadded(Uint8List)` helper; both decode paths call the shared private function.
items.closure_criteria: A single copyPadded helper with const _simdPadding = 64 serves every padded-copy site and both byte decode paths call it.

items.observation: The `_closed` check is written inline five times; at and exists repeat the same pointer-encoding + sjAt skeleton.
items.closure_criteria: The five inline _closed checks call a shared _checkOpen and the at and exists lookups share one private helper.

items.observation: exists builds and discards the value's tape on the native side (lines 302, 308-309). The existence mode of atMany (mode 1) does not do this. `exists('')` serializes the whole document.
items.proposed_fix: Route exists to the existence mode or a separate `sj_exists` shim entry; keep exists_test and add a cost measurement.
items.closure_criteria: exists routes through the atMany existence mode or a dedicated sj_exists shim entry. exists_test stays green and a recorded cost measurement shows the value tape is no longer built.

items.observation: `code == 9 || code == 10` depends on simdjson enum values; the vendored version or the enum location is not recorded. The behavior is covered by the decoder_test.dart:86 group.
items.proposed_fix: Return a named flag from the shim or record the vendored version and the enum names in a comment.
items.closure_criteria: The shim returns a named fallback flag or a comment records the vendored simd version and the enum names behind codes 9 and 10. The decoder_test.dart group at line 86 stays green.

items.observation: The default template comments are still there; only recommended.
items.proposed_fix: Clean up the template and turn on the image_ffi settings.
items.closure_criteria: analysis_options.yaml carries no template comments and enables the image_ffi strict settings with no new diagnostics from dart analyze.
